Replacement Rubber Tip For Deltana FDB278 Door Stops

text.description_html:
Deltana Floor Mount Door Stop Replacement Rubber Tip

This is a replacement gray rubber tip for the Deltana floor mount door stops. Easy to change. They are held in place with a small brad nail. Just pull the brad nail out, change the rubber bumper tip and press the brad nail back in.

Warning: These work for FDB218 Floor Mounted Door Stop and FDB278 Floor Mounted Door Stop manufactured by Deltana. If you are not sure if your door stops were manufactured by Deltana, do NOT order these as they may not fit properly.

*Sold individually - NO RETURNS
